scenarios.scenario_note: Seed: C2-bias-review.md §E1 (10 culture prompts + 2 controls; transcript evidence/c2/probe-interpret.out.txt). This scenario pins CURRENT honest behaviour as re-observed at the H4 capture (2026-10-07, post hotfixes H1/H2/H3) — it is a regression pin, NOT a classifier-accuracy claim, and not a statement that these phrases are 'handled' for real use. Defensive assertions: culture spans are never asserted as semantics (only quoted user echo + the 'not understood' assumption), the banned product-copy words (tribal/primitive/exotic) never appear in product-authored text (user echo is expected, must be quoted, and is counted in the evidence), every unparsed span is surfaced in asks, and no prompt dead-ends without an ask.
